sources.title: IJyad/whisper-large-v3-Tarteel · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description This model is a fine-tuned version of OpenAI's Whisper Large V3 model, adapted specifically for Arabic Quranic speech recognition using the Tarteel AI Everyayah Dataset. It is optimized to transcribe Quranic recitations with improved accuracy on this specialized dataset.

sources.snippet: Additionally, the turbo model is an optimized version of large-v3 that offers faster transcription speed with a minimal degradation in accuracy. Whisper's performance varies widely depending on the language.
